# `@videojs/spf/features/current-time`

Source: [src/playback/features/current-time.ts](../../../src/playback/features/current-time.ts)

## currentTimeFeature

Mirrors the media element's `currentTime` into state, which segment loading reads to plan what to load next.

### Behaviors

1. [trackCurrentTime](../behaviors/dom/track-current-time.md#trackcurrenttime)

### Config

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultCurrentTime?` | `number` | — | [trackCurrentTime](../behaviors/dom/track-current-time.md#trackcurrenttime) | Value written to `state.currentTime` when no media element is attached. Defaults to `0` — the HTMLMediaElement spec default. |

### State

| Key | Type | Initial | Declared by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currentTime` | `number \| undefined` | — | [trackCurrentTime](../behaviors/dom/track-current-time.md#trackcurrenttime) | Current playback position in seconds. Defaults to 0 when undefined. (doc of [loadVideoSegments](../behaviors/dom/load-segments.md#loadvideosegments)) |
